name: io.github.ma2no4413/outlook-mcp
title: Outlook Mailbox Tidier
description: Tidy a large Outlook / Hotmail mailbox. Folder subtree moves, bulk ops with dry run, never sends.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) ID from the Azure app registration. See docs/AZURE.en.md for how to obtain one.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the token cache file. In Docker, point this at a mounted volume so the sign-in survives restarts. The file is the key to the mailbox; never bake it into an image.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: common for personal and work/school accounts, consumers for personal Microsoft accounts only. Defaults to common.

environmentVariables.name: OUTLOOK_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to disable every write tool at once, leaving only search and read.
